name: Aggregation-utility subspace selection: independent three-task pilot
authorization: User 2026-10-26 supplied Pro share and explicitly requested implementing the new method and first three tasks on a GPU with spare VRAM; this resumes work after waiting for Pro.
base_revision: c7ce88f; scientific ConfirmationPilot unchanged from ten-task study
prefix: Fresh original-RRS T1 executed once. Same exact saved T1 model/history/RNG imported into all three T2/T3 arms. No final T10 checkpoint used for an earlier task. T3 probe data indices remain identical across arms; model-dependent pools and gradients reflect each arm own T2 trajectory.
pool: Preserve exact original FP32 RRS A0. Append the next 32 relative-response directions, project out A0 with a Gram solve twice, QR and concatenate P=[A0.T,Q_extra]. Original candidate Z0=[I;0] gives A0 exactly. Formal A=(P Z).T remains rank32.
probe: Task-start normalized current encoder CLS, fit-only pooled class sums/counts make a temporary cosine16 prototype head. Formal random head is preserved. Each local class deterministically split approx80/20, singleton stays fit. Current train-only data; no old images, test labels or future data. Formal training afterwards uses all current training images.
gradient: Each client uploads FP32 C_k=G_k P using zero temporary Q/V B_probe, with client mean CE over its split. Client weights equal split sample fractions, separately fit/check. Q and V separately use original five-step FP32 SSB at rank32 with momentum factor0.1 and denominator1e-7; no FedMuon scaling.

objectives.federated: sum_QV <sum_k p_k C_k Z, sum_k p_k SSB(0.1 C_k Z)>
objectives.central: sum_QV <sum_k p_k C_k Z, SSB(0.1 sum_k p_k C_k Z)>
objectives.rrs: Always exact original A0; same fit/check instrumentation for trajectory and overhead control.

historical_constraints: For BOTH learned arms: Gamma=tr(Z.T P.T H P Z) and actual LOCAL-SSB-then-average response R=sum_QV tr(Dfed Z.T P.T H P Z Dfed.T) must not exceed original-RRS budgets except predeclared numerical tolerance. This uses actual federated R even in the central-objective control.
search: At most60 projected feasible ascent steps per layer, tangent objective gradients with two linear inequality projections, QR retraction, up to16 backtracks. Initial step.25, inward derivative.001, relative constraint tolerance2e-6, relative utility gain1e-4, FP32 orthogonality/pool reconstruction tolerance1e-5. No global optimum claim. Numerical budget fixed before CIFAR execution.
check: Exactly one fit-selected FP32 candidate checked per layer. Recompute deployed FP32 utility, Gamma/R and orthogonality. Check uses split-specific mean gradients against the FIT update held fixed, with operator corresponding to the arm objective (central for B, federated for C). Positive check utility and relative gain1e-4 over RRS required. Reject=>exact A0, no re-search on check labels. Also log actual federated check utility for both arms and norm-matched direction diagnostics, never use them for another selection loop.
unchanged_training: Original current-only CE, RRS pool construction, B-only original SSB/sample-weighted FedAvg, cosine16 head AdamW.001 and spherical Head-RegMean alpha.5. FP32 deterministic algorithms/mathSDPA/TF32off. No boundary-evidence branch, teacher, distillation, replay or extra inference model.
interpretation: RRS improvement, not complete removal of RRS. Surrogate utility is first-order for one virtual step; history is archival patch-input response, neither a guarantee of finite-step loss nor no forgetting.
evaluation: All three complete to T3 regardless of scientific performance. Both fixed centered and raw full lower-triangular matrices, per-stage new/old/overall, T2-T3 mean new, AIA, forgetting, task-restricted accuracy and competition. Report accepted layers/fallback reasons/fit+check U/Gamma/R/update norms/projector distance/cost for both selection arms. No test tuning/checkpoint selection.
gate: Descriptive pilot gate: federated centered T3 overall and AIA strictly above both original RRS and central control; T3 old and T2-T3 mean-new not below original RRS; at least one accepted layer in each modified task and all accepted certificates valid. Report comparisons against central old/new separately. Failure blocks automatic expansion, no new seed or ten-task run is authorized.
qualification: Eight synthetic CPU tests cover original SSB, projected gradients, candidate pool, cancellation/rotation/first-order identity, independent-check fallback, split disjointness, unmodified RRS trajectory, prefix/RNG/clock/restart. Actual per-arm150 unique client-round/375k visits including50/125k shared;15 head certificates/3 histories+merges; final actual saved checkpoint reproduces raw+centered3000 predictions. Private gradient evidence retained for CPU audit.

cost.probe_cost: Actual prototype fit + disjoint fit/check backward image visits and logical tensor bytes recorded, without pretending these are free. Baseline instrumentation overhead separately disclosed.

resources.common_clock: Fresh T1 and all three branches share first actual execution start; no reset/retry/parallel subdivision. Scientific failures preserved without automatic costly rerun.
resources.shared_readonly: Prior data/deps/sources/manifests/weights linked only; all new caches/tmp/output under new root. Existing roots/history untouched.

privacy: Publish source/config/protocol/aggregate/certificates; keep checkpoint, projected gradients, Gram, prototype/features and per-image logits private.
monitor: Reuse only existing fcl30min heartbeat. Original four ten-task study has completed worker qualification but its LoRM1 final CPU audit/two-seed publication remains pending; preserve and deliver it independently. Close monitor only after both studies delivered, absent new authorized work.
proposal_source: User-provided Pro design, 2026-10-26: improve RRS by federated aggregation utility; retain SSB.
